newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cegetel confirms talks with NTT.
newsitem.headline: Cegetel confirms talks with NTT.

text.p: Cegetel on Tuesday confirmed it was in discussions with Japanese operator Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp about the latter taking a stake in Telecom Developpement (TD).
TD is a joint-venture between Cegetel and state railways group SNCF which operates a network of fibre-optic cables.
"The discussions are going on. Nothing has been decided at the moment," a Cegetel spokeswoman said.
Generale des Eaux is the majority shareholder in Cegetel, France's second telecoms operator in which British Telecommunications Plc is buying a 25 percent stake.

Cegetel is taking a 40 percent stake in SNCF's new subsidiary, called Telecom Development. But Cegetel may bring in another partner to take its stake up to 49.9 percent, a London-based source said adding NTT would take the 9.9 percent stake.
SNCF will keep at least 50 percent stake.
